TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
Zoning Narrative and Plans

VP 26" Pierce, LLC is the “Applicant” for a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for the subject property located at 3300 W. Pierce Avenue
(“Property”). The Property is improved with high |-story and 3-story brick building, built in 1899, and in recent years, operated as the
Salvation and Deliverance Ministries International. The Existing Building has been vacant and unoccupied for several years. The
Applicant is seeking to adaptively reuse the Existing Building by fully renovating the interior and converting it into a residential
development. There are no proposed expansions or additions to the Existing Building, rather the Applicant plans on retaining the exterior
brick, corner tower and stained glass and conduct needed repairs. In order to proceed with its proposed residential conversion of the
Existing Building, the Applicant is seeking to amend the Property’s existing RS3 Residential Single Unit (Detached House) District to
a B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

The Property contains a total of 5,953.10 sf and is located at the northwest corner of West Pierce Avenue and North Spaulding Avenue.
The Property is located within transit-served location (““TSL”) due to its close proximity (255 ft) to the North Avenue bus line corridor.
The Applicant plans to fully renovate the interior of,the Existing Building with twenty (20) dwelling units, which will include i. six (6)
1-bedroom units; ii. seven (7) 2-bedroom units; iii. five (5) 3-bedroom units and iv. two (2) 4-bedroom units. Six (6) of the twenty (20)
dwelling units, will be affordable dwelling units, at 60 percent Area Median Income (AMI). Twenty (20) bicycle spaces will be located
within the lower level of the Existing Building.

*Pursuant to 17-10-0102-B(1)(a) of the Chicago Zoning Code, the Applicant seeks to reduce its 20-space auto parking requirement
to zero, provided as of right.

**Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, as part of this Type | Zoning Map Amendment, the
Applicant seeks variations from the Chicago Zoning Ordinance to i) reduce the Existing Building’s existing front setback from the
required 9 ft. to zero and ii. reduce the Existing Building's existing side setback from the required 5.45 fi. to zero. ((§17-13-1101-
B). By granting this relief, the Existing Building will be brought into compliance with the Chicago Zoning Code.
